items.title: Towards a Risk Assessment of Malicious Skill Files in Coding Agents
items.summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly embedded in enterprise software workflows with delegated authority over connected systems. Central to this architecture is the agent skills interface: folders of instructions and scripts that agents load dynamically to specialize their behavior. This interface also widens the attack surface, letting malicious shell commands hide within natural-language skill files. We make three contributions. First, an adversarial skill-synthesis method using six LLMs across four families to transform 471 real-world shell commands into benign-appearing skills, released as a benchmark of 2,826 skills mapped to 11 MITRE ATT&CK tactics. Second, a reproducible evaluation pipeline coupling run stratification, evidence anchoring, a refusal veto, and a deterministic declared-intent override with a three-judge LLM-as-a-judge panel, validated against a blind human gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.85). Third, a large-scale characterization of two enterprise-grade agents across 5,629 completed runs. Gemini CLI is exploited in 95.5-96.1% of runs and Qwen Code in 71.6-74.0% (raw majority vote to declared-intent-corrected estimate, both within the human gold standard), nearly invariant to the generating model. Explicit safety recognition occurs in only 1.99% of runs. Enterprises must assess and mitigate skill-interface risk before adopting coding agents. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/awsm-research/AgentJailbreak

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自主编码智能体（coding agents）在进入企业软件工作流后所引入的新型安全风险进行了系统性研究。这类智能体通常被授予对连接系统的委派权限，其核心架构依赖“技能接口”（agent skills interface），即以文件夹形式存储的指令和脚本，智能体在运行时动态加载以完成特定任务。然而，这一接口也显著扩大了攻击面：恶意shell命令可以隐藏在看似无害的自然语言技能文件中，从而绕过传统安全检测。研究团队提出了三项主要贡献。第一，提出一种对抗性技能合成方法，利用来自四个系列的六种大型语言模型（LLMs），将471条真实世界shell命令转化为外观良性的恶意技能文件，构建了包含2826个技能样本的基准数据集，并映射到11种MITRE ATT&CK战术。第二，构建了一个可复现的评估流水线，包含运行分层、证据锚定、拒绝否决和确定性声明意图覆盖机制，并采用三人LLM评审团（LLM-as-a-judge）进行裁决；通过与人类盲审金标准（Cohen's kappa = 0.85）对比验证了该流水线的可靠性。第三，对两款企业级智能体（Gemini CLI和Qwen Code）进行了大规模实证评估，覆盖5629次完整运行。结果显示，Gemini CLI在95.5%-96.1%的运行中被成功利用，Qwen Code在71.6%-74.0%的运行中被利用（数值范围从原始多数投票到声明意图修正估计，均与人类金标准相符），且利用成功率几乎不受生成模型的影响。此外，显式安全识别率仅为1.99%，表明现有模型对恶意技能文件的防护能力严重不足。作者强调，企业在采用编码智能体之前，必须评估并缓解技能接口风险。代码和数据集已在GitHub上公开。本文适合安全研究人员、AI红队、DevSecOps工程师以及企业安全决策者阅读，以理解编码智能体供应链中的新型攻击面与评估方法论。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 编码智能体正被企业广泛采用，其技能接口可作为隐蔽攻击通道，使恶意指令绕过传统安全控制。本研究首次大规模量化了这一风险，提供可复现的评估方法，对安全审计和智能体供应链安全具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用编码智能体的企业，尤其是通过技能文件扩展智能体功能的场景。攻击者可投递恶意技能文件实现任意命令执行、数据窃取或持久化，且现有模型缺乏有效识别能力。
detection_signals_zh: 技能文件中包含可疑的shell命令或混淆脚本
智能体运行时出现异常的系统调用或网络连接
技能文件来源不可信或未经过安全审查
defense_advice_zh: 对技能文件实施严格的访问控制和内容审查，建立可信技能库
在智能体运行时实施最小权限原则，限制对敏感系统和数据的访问
部署监测机制，检测智能体执行过程中的异常行为
对已有技能进行安全扫描，识别潜在恶意模式

items.title: MOAT: Model-Agnostic Randomized Transformations for preventing Efficiency Degradation Attacks on ViTs
items.summary: To adopt the Vision Transformers (ViTs) in resource-constrained environment, token pruning is widely used to reduce computational cost without impacting accuracy. However, adversaries have developed targeted attacks against said token pruning techniques to undermine such attempts to make ViTs efficient. In this paper, we propose MOAT, a model-agnostic pre-processing defense pipeline that applies a combination of input transformations to protect efficient ViT implementations against adversarial efficiency attacks. MOAT operates directly on the input without requiring modifications to the model architecture or token pruning mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that, across all evaluated ViT models, MOAT limits GFLOPs degradation under adversarial attacks to within 3.4% of the original unattacked model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 视觉Transformer（ViT）凭借其强大的表示能力在计算机视觉任务中表现优异，但其较高的计算开销限制了在资源受限环境（如边缘设备）中的部署。为此，token剪枝技术被广泛采用，它通过动态丢弃不重要的token来降低计算成本，同时尽量保持模型精度。然而，对抗性攻击者可以利用这一机制，构造特定的输入样本，使得模型剪枝策略失效，迫使模型计算量急剧增加，从而导致服务降级或拒绝服务。这种针对效率的攻击严重威胁到基于ViT的实时应用。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种模型无关的预处理防御方法MOAT（Model-Agnostic Randomized Transformations）。MOAT通过在输入阶段应用一组随机变换组合来破坏攻击者精心设计的扰动模式，从而防止剪枝策略被恶意操纵。该方法的关键优势在于其模型无关性：它直接作用于输入图像，无需修改ViT的架构或token剪枝算法，因此可以轻松集成到现有系统中。论文在多种主流ViT模型上进行了实验验证，结果表明，在对抗攻击下，MOAT能使模型的计算量（以GFLOPs衡量）退化被控制在原始未受攻击模型的3.4%以内，显著增强了模型面对效率攻击时的鲁棒性。该研究为高效ViT的防御提供了新的思路，尤其适用于对实时性和资源占用有严格要求的边缘计算场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 高效AI系统面临新型对抗威胁——效率攻击，可导致计算量剧增甚至服务崩溃。MOAT提供了一种无需改动模型结构的通用防御思路，对边缘部署和计算资源受限环境中大量使用剪枝技术的实践场景具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响所有依赖token剪枝的ViT部署场景，如边缘设备、移动端推理、实时视频分析等。该方法模型无关，可迁移到其他使用输入变换进行防御的对抗攻击防护体系。
defense_advice_zh: 在ViT输入管道中引入随机图像变换（如随机缩放、裁剪、噪声等）以破坏攻击样本的干扰模式。
采用模型无关的预处理防御，避免修改模型或剪枝逻辑，降低维护成本。
针对资源受限环境，将MOAT作为标准预处理步骤之一，提升对效率攻击的弹性。

items.why_it_matters: 高效AI系统面临新型对抗威胁——效率攻击，可导致计算量剧增甚至服务崩溃。MOAT提供了一种无需改动模型结构的通用防御思路，对边缘部署和计算资源受限环境中大量使用剪枝技术的实践场景具有重要参考价值。

items.title: A Survey of Adversarial Efficiency Degradation for Vision Transformer by Exploiting Input-adaptive Optimization
items.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) increasingly rely on input-adaptive inference, such as token pruning and early halting, to meet energy and latency budgets. This survey examines a recent class of adversarial efficiency degradation attacks that target these mechanisms to increase computation without necessarily degrading accuracy. We unify and compare two representative attacks, SlowFormer (a universal adversarial patch) and DeSparsify (per-image perturbations), across three popular token-pruning frameworks: A-ViT, ATS, and AdaViT. We standardize reporting using GFLOPs, accuracy loss, and an Attack Success (AS) metric that measures how much of the model's compute savings the attack takes away. Understanding these attacks is crucial for designing countermeasures that not only mitigate risk but also remain lightweight, since deployment often occurs in low-power settings such as mobile or embedded devices. To organize our analysis, we focus on three questions: how input-adaptive optimizations (e.g., token pruning and early halting) create attack surfaces for efficiency degradation; how such attacks operate in practice and which optimizations are most vulnerable; and which defenses exist today and whether they meaningfully restore efficiency under attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于针对视觉Transformer（ViT）的对抗性效率降低攻击的综述。随着ViT在边缘设备上部署，为了满足能耗和延迟预算，越来越多地采用输入自适应的推理机制，如token剪枝和提前停止。这些机制根据输入复杂度动态调整计算量，但也引入了新的攻击面。本文聚焦于一类特殊攻击：它们不追求破坏模型准确性，而是通过增加计算开销来降低推理效率，从而耗尽设备的计算资源或导致拒绝服务。文章统一并比较了两个代表性攻击：SlowFormer，一种通用对抗补丁，可附加到任意图像上；以及DeSparsify，针对每个图像生成扰动。这两个攻击被应用于三个流行的token剪枝框架：A-ViT、ATS和AdaViT进行测试。为了标准化评估，作者引入了以GFLOPs作为计算量指标、准确率损失以及攻击成功率（AS）的度量标准，其中攻击成功率衡量攻击从模型节省的计算量中夺走的比例。文章围绕三个核心问题展开分析：第一，输入自适应优化（如token剪枝和提前停止）如何为效率降低攻击创造攻击面；第二，这些攻击在实践中如何运作，哪些优化机制最为脆弱；第三，目前存在哪些防御措施，以及它们能否在攻击下有效恢复效率。总体而言，这篇综述强调了理解此类攻击对于设计既安全又轻量的防御措施的重要性，尤其考虑到移动和嵌入式设备等低功耗场景的限制。适合ViT模型设计者、边缘AI安全研究人员以及部署者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着ViT在移动端/嵌入式等资源受限设备上的广泛部署，输入自适应推理带来的效率提升成为关键。本文揭示的攻击可悄悄消耗掉这些节省的计算资源，导致电池耗尽、延迟增大，甚至影响物理系统的实时性。安全从业者需要关注这一新兴攻击面，以便在架构设计时加入轻量级防御。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用token剪枝、提前停止等输入自适应机制的ViT模型，尤其是在低功耗边缘设备上（如手机、IoT）。攻击可在不显著损失准确率的情况下，使模型计算量大幅上升，破坏系统性能。
defense_advice_zh: 设计轻量级防御机制，在不显著增加计算开销的前提下检测或缓解此类攻击。

items.why_it_matters: 随着ViT在移动端/嵌入式等资源受限设备上的广泛部署，输入自适应推理带来的效率提升成为关键。本文揭示的攻击可悄悄消耗掉这些节省的计算资源，导致电池耗尽、延迟增大，甚至影响物理系统的实时性。安全从业者需要关注这一新兴攻击面，以便在架构设计时加入轻量级防御。

items.title: Blockchain Empowered Trustworthy Agent Networks: Foundations, Taxonomy, and Future Directions
items.summary: AI agents are evolving from isolated task executors into networked autonomous entities that can communicate, delegate tasks, invoke tools, access external knowledge, and participate in cross-platform service and economic workflows. This evolution gives rise to open agent networks, where heterogeneous agents owned by different stakeholders interact without naturally shared infrastructures for identity, authorization, auditability, reputation, or settlement. This survey and tutorial article reviews the literature over the period 1980--2026 on the evolution from classical multi-agent systems to open agent networks, with a particular focus on LLM-based autonomous agents, agent interoperability protocols, Internet-of-Agents infrastructures, and blockchain-enabled trust mechanisms. We first review this evolution and show how the trust boundary expands from individual execution to cross-agent, cross-platform, and cross-organizational interaction. We then identify a network-level trust crisis that cannot be fully addressed by single-agent safety mechanisms or closed multi-agent coordination techniques, and develop a five-dimensional taxonomy covering entity and capability trust, authorization and delegation trust, information and provenance trust, coordination and group-robustness trust, and accountability and settlement trust. Based on this taxonomy, we examine how blockchain can provide shared identity, verifiable authorization, tamper-evident provenance, auditable collaboration, incentive alignment, and value settlement for trustworthy agent networks. We further synthesize the mapping between agent-network risks, trust requirements, and blockchain-enabled mechanisms, and clarify the role of blockchain as a shared trust layer rather than a replacement for agent security, semantic verification, privacy protection, or robust reasoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于区块链赋能可信智能体网络的综述与教程文章，由北京理工大学等机构的研究者撰写。文章首先回顾了从1980年代经典多智能体系统到2026年间智能体架构的演进，指出AI智能体正从孤立的任务执行器演变为能够通信、委派任务、调用工具、访问外部知识并参与跨平台服务与经济流程的网络化自治实体。这种演进催生了开放智能体网络（Open Agent Networks），其中不同利益相关者拥有的异构智能体在缺乏共享身份、授权、审计、声誉和结算基础设施的情况下交互。作者梳理了这一演进过程，特别关注基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体、智能体互操作协议、智能体互联网基础设施以及区块链赋能的信任机制。文章提出，随着信任边界从单智能体执行扩展到跨智能体、跨平台、跨组织交互，出现了一种网络级信任危机，而单智能体安全机制或封闭式多智能体协调技术无法完全应对。为此，作者构建了一个五维分类体系，涵盖实体与能力信任、授权与委派信任、信息与来源信任、协调与群体鲁棒性信任、以及问责与结算信任。基于该分类，文章系统分析了区块链如何提供共享身份、可验证授权、防篡改来源、可审计协作、激励对齐和价值结算，从而支撑可信智能体网络。最后，作者综合了智能体网络风险、信任要求与区块链机制之间的映射关系，并明确指出区块链的角色是作为共享信任层，而非替代智能体安全、语义验证、隐私保护或鲁棒推理。本文适合从事智能体安全、区块链应用和分布式系统研究的学者及希望理解开放智能体网络信任基础设施的安全工程师阅读，为其提供系统性的理论框架与未来研究方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着LLM智能体从单体走向开放网络，身份、授权、审计等信任基础设施缺失成为现实威胁。本文首次系统梳理了区块链作为共享信任层的潜力，为设计安全可靠的多智能体协作系统提供了理论框架。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 为开放智能体网络的安全架构设计提供参考，可迁移至智能体互操作协议、去中心化身份管理、可审计协作等领域。

items.title: Adaptive Intrusion Detection System using Transformer-Based Neural Networks and Continual Learning Approach with Adversarial Investigation
items.summary: Network intrusion detection systems (IDS) trained on fixed traffic snapshots decay silently after deployment as threat distributions shift. Fine-tuning models on new attacks triggers catastrophic forgetting, while retraining from scratch is computationally infeasible. Replay-based continual learning counters this, but existing methods unrealistically confine benign traffic to a single early task and ignore the replay buffer as a potential attack surface. To address this, we present an adaptive IDS framework coupling a tabular transformer encoder with a class balanced experience replay buffer that replays benign traffic at every update to stabilize decision boundaries. We introduce the class-instance incremental (CII) scenario where benign flows reappear alongside new attacks as a more faithful stress test, and probe the buffer with overt label flipping and stealthy backdoor poisoning attacks. On the CICIDS2017 benchmark, our framework achieved 0.9994 accuracy under the traditional class incremental setup and 0.9989 under CII, with negligible forgetting, drastically outperforming sequential fine-tuning (0.0052), EWC (0.0324), LwF (0.0699), and iCaRL (0.8770) baselines. While injecting benign traffic into every experience proves essential for preventing forgetting, the replay buffer introduces critical vulnerabilities. Label-flipping collapses the model entirely (0.0053 accuracy at a 1% budget), and the backdoor maintains 0.97 overall accuracy while driving the attack success rate on trigger flows to 95%, evading standard monitoring. Ultimately, while a modest replay budget recovers near-joint-training performance, ensuring buffer integrity emerges as a strict operational requirement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的适应性入侵检测系统（IDS）框架，旨在解决传统IDS在固定流量快照上训练后，因威胁分布漂移导致的性能衰退问题。现有方法在应对新攻击时，微调会导致灾难性遗忘，而从头重训练计算成本过高。基于回放的持续学习虽能缓解遗忘，但现有方法不现实地将良性流量限制在单个早期任务中，且忽略了回放缓冲区本身可能成为攻击面。为此，作者将表格型Transformer编码器与类别均衡的经验回放缓冲区相结合，在每次更新时回放良性流量以稳定决策边界。同时，他们提出了类别-实例增量（CII）场景，即良性流量与新攻击同时出现，作为更真实的压力测试，并对回放缓冲区进行了显式标签翻转和隐蔽后门投毒攻击实验。在CICIDS2017基准上，该框架在传统类增量设置下达到0.9994的准确率，在CII设置下达到0.9989，遗忘极小，显著优于序列微调（0.0052）、EWC（0.0324）、LwF（0.0699）和iCaRL（0.8770）等基线。然而，实验也揭示回放缓冲区存在严重漏洞：1%预算的标签翻转使模型准确率崩坏至0.0053；后门攻击在保持整体准确率0.97的同时，对触发器流的攻击成功率高达95%，且能规避标准监控。研究表明，将良性流量注入每次经验是防止遗忘的关键，但缓冲区完整性成为严格的操作要求。本文适合网络安全研究者、IDS开发者和机器学习安全从业者阅读，以理解持续学习在入侵检测中的应用及其安全隐患。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了持续学习型IDS面临的新攻击面：回放缓冲区可被投毒导致模型崩溃或植入后门，且隐蔽性强。这对依赖增量学习的蓝队防御体系有直接警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响采用增量学习/回放机制的入侵检测系统，若缓冲区未受保护，攻击者可操纵历史数据降低检测能力或植入隐蔽后门。也可迁移至其他持续学习场景（如恶意软件分类）。
detection_signals_zh: 监控回放缓冲区数据异常修改或异常添加
模型在不同类别上的准确率突然恶化
特定触发流量行为与正常模式偏离
defense_advice_zh: 对回放缓冲区实施完整性校验和访问控制
采用差分隐私或鲁棒聚合方法增强抗投毒能力
定期审计缓冲区内容及模型行为一致性

items.title: Innocent Panels, Hateful Stories: Evaluating and Detecting Hateful Intent in Multi-Turn Visual Story Generation
items.summary: Picture books and comics have long been used to disseminate hateful narratives because they are easily understood even by children, as exemplified by the notorious Nazi propaganda picture book \emph{Der Giftpilz}. Recently, frontier text-to-image (T2I) systems such as Gemini and GPT-Image have enabled conversational generation with consistent characters and scenes across turns, making hateful visual stories, namely ordered image groups that collectively convey hateful narratives, cheap and scalable to produce. Although prior work has studied hateful content generation by T2I systems, it focuses on individual images, leaving group-level hateful meaning largely unexplored. We aim to address the gap. Concretely, we introduce \texttt{HatefulStoryPrompts}, comprising 330 multi-turn configurations from 55 hateful stories across two languages and three visual styles, and evaluate five frontier models over 4,950 attempts. Every model completes over 80\% of the stories, with the strongest reaching 99.0\%. We further evaluate existing moderation systems on \texttt{HatefulVisualStory}, a human-labeled dataset of 969 hateful image sets and 990 benign controls, and find that they frequently miss group-level hateful meaning: dedicated safety models achieve at most 34.9\% recall, while a strong vision-language model reaches 67.5\%. Finally, we propose complementary proactive and post-generation defenses. An interaction-aware monitor achieves 97.3\% recall for prompt-only sessions and 92.6\% when the user supplies the first image, while post-generation methods jointly analyzing completed image groups reach 80.2\%. Our work shows that, as image generation evolves from isolated outputs to coherent visual narratives, safety must evolve accordingly, from per-image moderation to stateful reasoning over interactions and image relationships.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对文本到图像（T2I）系统在多轮对话中生成连贯视觉故事时可能传播仇恨叙事的问题展开研究。作者指出，图画书和漫画因其易于理解的特点，历史上常被用于传播仇恨内容（如纳粹宣传画册《Der Giftpilz》）。随着Gemini、GPT-Image等前沿T2I系统支持跨轮次保持角色和场景一致性，生成“仇恨视觉故事”（即有序图像组，整体传达仇恨叙事）变得低成本且可规模化。以往研究仅关注单张图像的仇恨内容，缺乏对图像组层面集体语义的考察。为填补这一空白，作者构建了HatefulStoryPrompts数据集，包含55个仇恨故事、330种多轮配置，覆盖两种语言和三种视觉风格，并对5个前沿模型进行了4950次生成尝试。结果显示所有模型都能完成超过80%的故事，最强模型完成率达99.0%。作者还构建了人工标注数据集HatefulVisualStory（含969个仇恨图像组和990个良性对照组），评估现有审核系统后发现它们经常漏掉组级仇恨含义：专用安全模型召回率最高仅34.9%，而强大的视觉语言模型召回率可达67.5%。最后，作者提出主动式与生成后防御相结合的方案：交互感知监控器在仅提示词会话中召回率达97.3%，用户提供首图时召回率为92.6%；针对完整图像组的生成后联合分析方法召回率达80.2%。本文表明，随着图像生成从独立输出演变为连贯视觉叙事，安全机制也必须从单图审核升级为对交互和图像关系的状态化推理。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了多模态AI安全的新盲区：现有审核机制仅检查单张图像，无法识别跨图像组的仇恨叙事。为防御方提供了针对生成式视觉故事的风险评估方法和检测思路，对构建下一代内容安全系统具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用T2I系统生成连环画、漫画、图文故事等场景的合规性；现有图像审核API和模型可能漏检组级语义攻击，需要引入时序与交互推理能力。
detection_signals_zh: 多轮对话中连续生成的图像组在内容上存在隐含的歧视、敌对或极端叙事关联
用户通过分步引导、角色一致化等方式掩盖单张图像的恶意性
图像组之间存在跨帧的语义连贯性，但单帧无法触发现有内容审核规则
defense_advice_zh: 在图像生成系统中引入交互感知的监控器，跟踪多轮生成历史并判断整体语义
对已生成的图像组进行后置联合分析，利用视觉语言模型推理跨图像关系
建立针对仇恨视觉故事的专项测试集，定期评估现有审核系统的组级召回率
考虑将单图像审核策略升级为状态化、上下文相关的安全策略

items.title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
items.summary: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索代理面临的安全威胁，特别是通过操纵搜索结果来实施提示注入和目的劫持的攻击。现有防御研究主要关注静态网页的单一注入，但现代搜索代理会进行多轮查询并交叉验证多源信息，导致单点注入往往被稀释或忽略。作者发现，代理所依赖的搜索结果和页面内容传递通道本质上是一个脆弱的安全边界，攻击者可通过控制一个中间工具接口，在每次查询中附加一个受控结果，并沿着代理的整个执行轨迹协调这些注入，从而显著提高攻击成功率。为此，作者提出一种策略驱动的长时程攻击框架，并引入专家精炼策略——权威链劫持（ACH），该策略能够将分散的搜索结果和页面内容篡改整合为一条围绕看似相互印证的多来源证据链，从而有效误导代理生成错误结论。在SafeSearch基准测试上，ACH取得了最高的攻击成功率，总体ASR为55.9%，MaxN ASR达83.3%。此外，论文还提出追踪引导策略进化（TGSE）方法，能够根据代理的执行轨迹自动改进攻击策略，避免了人工重新设计，其最强配置在留出集上达到71.4%的ASR和95.0%的MaxN ASR。本工作揭示了LLM搜索代理在工具交互层面的新安全弱点，对设计更健壮的代理防御机制具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统性地展示了通过中介搜索接口实施跨轨迹协调注入的威胁，突破了传统单点注入防御。搜索代理在AI应用中广泛部署，此风险直接影响依赖实时检索的助手、RAG系统等，提示安全社区需重视工具层的可信边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该攻击模式可迁移至任何基于LLM的工具调用场景，如：AI驱动的浏览器、企业知识库检索、自动化研究助手等。由于只需控制少量搜索结果，对敌对服务提供商或恶意网页具有较低实施门槛。
detection_signals_zh: 代理执行日志中出现大量来自同一可疑来源的搜索结果
代理最终答案与用户明确指令或常识出现显著偏离
多次查询中检索到的不同页面针对同一主题呈现高度一致且带引导性的信息
defense_advice_zh: 对代理检索到的内容进行来源可信度评估，并对低信誉来源做降权处理
在代理决策过程中引入对抗性输入检测，识别具有诱导性的文本模式
对工具返回结果实施完整性校验，防止中间人篡改
限制代理对单次查询结果的依赖，强制要求多源交叉验证并公示证据链
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部安全评估，研究针对LLM代理工具层的防御机制；同时跟进该团队后续工作。

items.title: Checked-In Secret Detection: Strings Are All You Need
items.summary: Hardcoded secrets in source code pose critical security vulnerabilities which can be easily exploited by malicious adversaries. Existing regex-based detection approaches suffer from fundamental limitations, as secrets often lack identifiable patterns, resulting in poor precision and recall. Recent studies have explored context-aware detection methods, as surrounding code can reveal the purpose of candidate strings. However, these methods confront three key challenges: (1) obfuscation robustness where models over-rely on easily obfuscated identifiers, (2) cross-language generalization difficulties due to uneven training data distribution, and (3) lengthy and noisy context that introduces excessive irrelevant tokens and slows inference. We observe that strings serve as a critical information source for code semantics, offering superior contextual density, obfuscation robustness, and language independence. Based on this insight, we propose StringGroup, a novel context extraction algorithm that mines strings surrounding potential secrets. By introducing a relatively simple modification to existing patterns that narrows the analysis specifically to string literals, the method achieves significant gains. With only 33.2% of the original context, it preserves over 80% of semantic information and significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio for secret detection. We further design a context-aware secret detection tool, Secretron, based on StringGroup methods and Transformer model. Evaluation on the SecretBench dataset demonstrates high accuracy with 98.74% F1-score and strong robustness under obfuscation and cross-language scenarios, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines. We deploy our tool in real-world environments and successfully detect 48 previously unknown secret keys from 26 applications, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of our approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对源代码中硬编码密钥（hardcoded secrets）这一严重安全漏洞展开研究。现有基于正则表达式的检测方法因密钥往往缺乏可识别模式而存在精度和召回率低下的根本性局限。近期研究尝试利用上下文感知检测，通过分析候选字符串周围的代码来推断其用途，但仍面临三大挑战：一是混淆鲁棒性不足，模型过度依赖容易被混淆的标识符；二是跨语言泛化困难，训练数据分布不均导致效果不稳定；三是上下文长而嘈杂，引入大量无关标记并拖慢推理速度。论文作者观察到字符串本身是代码语义的关键信息源，具有更高的上下文密度、更强的混淆鲁棒性和更好的语言无关性。基于这一洞见，他们提出名为 StringGroup 的新型上下文提取算法，专门挖掘潜在密钥周围的字符串字面量。通过对现有模式进行相对简单的修改，将分析范围聚焦于字符串字面量，方法在仅使用原始上下文 33.2% 的情况下保留了超过 80% 的语义信息，显著提高了密钥检测的信噪比。作者进一步基于 StringGroup 方法和 Transformer 模型设计了上下文感知的密钥检测工具 Secretron。在 SecretBench 数据集上的评估显示，该工具实现了 98.74% 的 F1 分数，并在混淆和跨语言场景下表现出强鲁棒性，优于当前最先进的基于 LLM 的基线方法。此外，作者已在真实环境中部署该工具，成功从 26 个应用中检测出 48 个先前未知的密钥，验证了其实用有效性。该研究为代码安全审计中的敏感信息泄露检测提供了高效且可落地的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬编码密钥是真实且高发的安全风险，现有检测工具精度有限。该研究提出基于字符串上下文的高效检测方法，用更少上下文获得更高准确率，且兼顾混淆鲁棒性与跨语言能力，对蓝队自动化审计代码仓库中的敏感信息泄露有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 CI/CD 流水线、代码仓库扫描、云密钥泄露防护等场景，尤其适合大型多语言仓库中的密钥检测与分类，能有效降低误报和漏报。

items.why_it_matters: 硬编码密钥是真实且高发的安全风险，现有检测工具精度有限。该研究提出基于字符串上下文的高效检测方法，用更少上下文获得更高准确率，且兼顾混淆鲁棒性与跨语言能力，对蓝队自动化审计代码仓库中的敏感信息泄露有直接参考价值。

items.title: UC, Categorically: Rigorous Diagrammatic Proofs
items.summary: Category theory is a mathematical theory of composition, widely used in logic, computing, and physics. Here we apply it to give a theory of secure composition. In particular, we provide a categorical treatment of Canetti's Universal Composability (UC) framework for systems with a static number of parties and sessions, often termed UC for static systems, yielding four benefits. First, we present our results graphically yet retain rigor by applying a standard categorical technique known as string diagrams. In particular, our formulation of the composition theorem can be graphically verified with a short sequence of diagrams, while remaining translatable to equations and amenable to formal verification. Second, categories let us generalize so that our results extend beyond interactive Turing machines to other forms of computation, such as quantum computation or domain-specific languages. Third, categories help us drop some unnecessary restrictions of UC (e.g., our adversary can be a computational network rather than a single Turing machine); we prove equivalence between our variant and the usual UC, showing no expressiveness is lost. Finally, the categorical perspective leads us to identify and correct some minor technical oversights in the standard formulation of simple UC.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文来自密码学与形式化方法交叉领域，旨在为 Canetti 提出的通用可组合性（UC）安全框架建立严格的范畴论基础。作者认为，传统 UC 框架依赖交互式图灵机（ITM）和复杂的组合证明，既难以图形化理解，也限制了其向量子计算等非经典计算模型的推广。论文的核心方法是引入范畴论中的 string diagrams（字符串图）技术，将安全组合定理的证明转化为直观的图形推导，同时保留严格的数学可翻译性和形式化验证能力。具体而言，作者针对静态参与方和会话数量的静态 UC 系统，给出了一个范畴论重构，实现了四个主要贡献：第一，通过图形化证明序列简洁地验证组合定理，并可与等式相互转换；第二，将结果泛化到任意计算模型，包括量子计算和领域特定语言，不再局限于图灵机；第三，放宽了 UC 中不必要的限制，例如允许对抗方为计算网络而非单一图灵机，并证明了该变体与标准 UC 在表达能力上等价；第四，利用范畴论视角发现了标准简单 UC 公式中的若干微小技术疏漏并予以纠正。该工作并非提供新的攻击或防御技术，而是为密码协议安全性分析提供更抽象、更可组合、更可验证的理论框架。适合密码学研究人员、形式化方法专家、安全协议设计者以及关注可组合安全性的理论计算机科学工作者阅读。由于仅依据摘要，本摘要未涉及实验数据或系统实现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 UC 安全框架提供严格的范畴论基础，使复杂的安全组合证明变得图形化、可验证，并能扩展到量子计算等新模型，有助于减少协议分析中的人为错误与形式化鸿沟。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响安全协议的形式化验证工具与可组合安全性理论，为更广泛的计算模型（如量子协议）提供安全组合方法论，但近期不具备直接产品化影响。

items.why_it_matters: 为 UC 安全框架提供严格的范畴论基础，使复杂的安全组合证明变得图形化、可验证，并能扩展到量子计算等新模型，有助于减少协议分析中的人为错误与形式化鸿沟。

items.title: DeepInvert: Semi-Supervised Embedding Inversion Against Obfuscated Language Models
items.summary: Cloud-based language model services routinely process prompts containing sensitive information. Obfuscation-based defenses---including ObfusLM, SentinelLMs, TextObfuscator, and DPNR---mitigate this risk by transforming prompt representations before transmission, offering a lightweight alternative to cryptographic solutions. We show these defenses provide far less protection than previously believed. We present DeepInvert, a semi-supervised embedding inversion attack that recovers original tokens from obfuscated representations with higher accuracy than prior methods. The key insight is that unlabeled obfuscated embeddings retain exploitable semantic structure despite perturbation. DeepInvert combines supervised training on labeled shadow data with a novel unsupervised consistency objective over unlabeled target embeddings, alternating between the two via a mixed training pipeline. Defense-aware adaptations further extend the attack to diverse obfuscation mechanisms across encoder-based and autoregressive architectures. Experiments on nine defenses, five tasks, and four model architectures show that DeepInvert outperforms prior attacks on most defenses. Against ObfusLM, DeepInvert achieves 73.5\% top-1 token recovery versus 26.2\% for the previous best. Our results reveal a task-dependent tension: obfuscation schemes preserving enough signal for utility also retain sufficient structure for inversion, while schemes resisting inversion collapse utility. On simpler classification tasks, some DP-based defenses can maintain both. We call for a re-evaluation of this defense class.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 DeepInvert 的半监督嵌入逆向攻击方法，针对基于混淆的防御机制（如 ObfusLM、SentinelLMs、TextObfuscator 和 DPNR）对云端语言模型提示词进行隐私保护的场景。这些混淆防御通过在处理前转换提示词的表示形式来降低敏感信息泄露风险，被视为比密码学方案更轻量的替代方案。然而，作者证明这些防御提供的保护远低于预期。DeepInvert 能够从混淆后的嵌入表示中以高于现有方法的准确率恢复原始 token。其核心洞察在于：即使经过扰动，未标记的混淆嵌入仍保留可利用的语义结构。该方法结合了在标记影子数据上的监督训练和针对未标记目标嵌入的新型无监督一致性目标，通过混合训练流程交替优化。此外，作者还提出了防御感知的扩展版本，使其能够适应多种混淆机制，覆盖基于编码器和自回归架构的模型。实验在九种防御、五个任务和四种模型架构上进行，结果显示 DeepInvert 在大多数防御上都优于现有攻击。例如，针对 ObfusLM，DeepInvert 的 top-1 token 恢复率达到 73.5%，而之前最佳方法仅为 26.2%。研究还揭示了任务相关的矛盾：保留足够任务效用的混淆方案往往也保留了足够的结构信息用于逆向攻击，而抵抗逆转的方案则会导致效用下降。在较简单的分类任务中，某些基于差分隐私的防御可以同时维持效用和抗攻击性。作者呼吁重新评估这一类防御机制的有效性。本文对云端 LLM 服务的隐私风险提出了重要警示，适合关注大模型安全、隐私保护和对抗性攻击的研究人员及安全保障团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究揭示当前流行的混淆型 LLM 隐私防御可被高效逆向攻击突破，直接影响依赖此类防护的云端 AI 服务安全评估与合规决策，需引起蓝队对现有防护方案的重新审视。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用混淆嵌入方式保护提示词的 LLM 服务及第三方防护产品，特别是基于 ObfusLM 等方案的系统；攻击可导致用户敏感信息泄露。
detection_signals_zh: 监控对 LLM API 的异常高频请求模式，可能对应嵌入逆向攻击试探
检测模型输出中是否出现与输入提示高度相似的片段，提示可能发生了 token 恢复
对使用混淆嵌入的接口，定期执行嵌入空间相似性审计
defense_advice_zh: 避免单独依赖混淆方案，应结合差分隐私、可信执行环境等更强保护
在部署混淆防御时进行针对性的嵌入逆向攻击评估，验证实际防护强度
对于高敏感任务，限制模型返回结果中与原始 token 直接相关的信息

items.why_it_matters: 这项研究揭示当前流行的混淆型 LLM 隐私防御可被高效逆向攻击突破，直接影响依赖此类防护的云端 AI 服务安全评估与合规决策，需引起蓝队对现有防护方案的重新审视。

items.title: ASTELD: A Six-Axis Classification Framework for Autonomous AI Agents - Design, Evaluation, and an OpenClaw Case Study
items.summary: Autonomous AI agent platforms differ substantially in architecture, security, tool integration, execution, autonomy, and deployment, yet the field lacks a common classification scheme for comparing these design choices. We propose ASTELD, an operational six-axis classification framework for autonomous AI agents: Architecture pattern, Security posture, Tool integration model, Execution paradigm, Level of autonomy and human control, and Deployment topology. ASTELD is constructed by synthesizing prior agent taxonomies with observable platform properties and explicit category-assignment rules. We evaluate its discriminative and explanatory utility by mapping eight representative frameworks and by using OpenClaw as an in-depth case study. The resulting profiles separate all eight platforms under their dominant configurations and reveal three cross-platform patterns: a security-accessibility diagonal, strong execution-architecture coupling, and capability convergence with persistent architectural differentiation. We further classify 50+ OpenClaw derivatives and find that innovation concentrates on the Security, Execution, and Deployment axes, indicating that ASTELD can explain where ecosystem fragmentation occurs. The OpenClaw case study also supplies a six-category vulnerability taxonomy, evidence from five institutional assessments, and adoption and governance analyses that connect platform coordinates to observed risks. These results position ASTELD as a reproducible method for comparing agent platforms, identifying unoccupied design regions, guiding framework selection, and organizing future empirical research. The analysis also exposes a consequential empty region: none of the evaluated systems combines local-first deployment with enterprise-grade security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并评估了一个用于自主AI代理平台分类的六轴框架ASTELD，旨在解决当前该领域缺乏统一分类方案的问题。ASTELD包含六个维度：架构模式（Architecture pattern）、安全态势（Security posture）、工具集成模型（Tool integration model）、执行范式（Execution paradigm）、自主性与人类控制级别（Level of autonomy and human control），以及部署拓扑（Deployment topology）。该框架通过综合既有代理分类法、可观察的平台属性和明确的类别分配规则构建。作者使用八个代表性框架进行映射，并以OpenClaw作为深度案例研究，评估了ASTELD的区分力和解释力。结果显示，ASTELD能够区分所有八个平台的主导配置，并揭示了三个跨平台模式：安全-可访问性对角线、强执行-架构耦合，以及能力趋同但架构持续差异化。进一步对50多个OpenClaw衍生平台进行分类后发现，创新集中在安全、执行和部署轴线上，表明ASTELD可解释生态系统碎片化发生的领域。OpenClaw案例研究还提供了六类漏洞分类法、来自五项机构评估的证据，以及将平台坐标与观察到的风险联系起来的采用与治理分析。研究还发现了一个重要的空白区域：所有被评估的系统均未将本地优先部署与企业级安全相结合。这些结果使ASTELD成为一种可复现的方法，用于比较代理平台、识别未占据的设计区域、指导框架选择以及组织未来的实证研究。本文适合AI安全研究员、代理平台开发者、安全架构师及制定AI治理策略的人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为安全人员提供了评估和比较自主AI代理平台安全性的结构化方法，有助于识别平台在安全、部署等维度的薄弱环节，尤其对于选择或审计代理平台的企业安全团队具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该框架可迁移至企业内部AI代理选型、安全审查、风险建模场景，并有助于发现市场现有产品在安全与部署组合上的空白，为安全要求高的环境提供决策依据。

items.title: Season: Spectrum-Aware Orthogonal Gradient Refinement for Transfer-Based Adversarial Attacks
items.summary: Transfer-based adversarial attacks often transfer poorly across heterogeneous architectures because CNNs favor local textures while Vision Transformers (ViTs) rely on global shapes. We propose Season, a spectrum-aware orthogonal gradient refinement framework for L-infinity transfer attacks against black-box target models on ImageNet, using a white-box surrogate. Season decomposes each update into a low-frequency branch capturing structural cues and a high-frequency branch capturing textures. A low-saliency guidance scheme reallocates high-frequency energy to background regions, preserving foreground structures that ViTs depend on. An orthogonal projection then forces the textural update to lie in the orthogonal complement of the structural direction, mitigating feature interference. As a training-free plug-and-play wrapper, Season enhances eight gradient-stabilization and input-enhancement attacks without modifying their cores. Across eight CNN, ViT, and MLP targets, Season improves transfer success rate by 6.6 percentage points on average and up to 16.0 points over strong baselines under a unified protocol.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Season 的频谱感知正交梯度细化框架，用于提升基于迁移的对抗攻击成功率。研究背景是：传统卷积神经网络（CNN）偏向利用局部纹理特征，而视觉 Transformer（ViT）依赖全局形状信息，这种特征偏好差异导致对抗样本在不同架构之间迁移性较差。Season 的核心思想是将每次迭代的梯度更新分解为低频分支和高频分支：低频分支捕获结构线索，高频分支捕获纹理细节。通过低显著性引导机制，将高频能量重新分配到图像背景区域，从而保留 ViT 依赖的前景结构信息。随后，利用正交投影迫使纹理更新方向位于结构方向的零空间中，以缓解特征干扰。作为一个无需训练、即插即用的包装器，Season 可以增强现有梯度稳定化和输入增强类攻击方法（共 8 种），而不修改其核心算法。在 ImageNet 数据集上，使用白盒替身模型针对黑盒目标模型，Season 在 CNN、ViT、MLP 共 8 种目标模型上平均提升迁移成功率 6.6 个百分点，最高提升 16.0 个百分点，且实验协议统一、对比基准较强。该研究主要面向对抗攻击研究人员、模型鲁棒性研究者以及关注黑盒攻击评估的安全从业者，帮助理解跨架构迁移性的机制，并为防御侧的输入预处理、频谱滤波等研究提供参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对抗样本跨架构迁移性威胁实际部署的 AI 系统，理解其频谱与正交投影原理有助于设计防御手段，如频谱异常检测或结构感知增强。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该框架适用于图像分类场景，可迁移至目标检测、语义分割等视觉任务，对黑盒模型安全评估有直接影响。
detection_signals_zh: 输入图像的高频分量在背景区域存在异常能量集中
多次迭代更新中的低频与高频成分呈现异常正交关系
黑盒模型对添加结构性扰动的输入产生不一致输出
defense_advice_zh: 对输入图像进行频谱滤波或低通预处理以削弱高频对抗扰动
在模型中引入对结构信息更鲁棒的注意力机制或数据增强
采用多模型集成或对抗训练提升对跨架构攻击的鲁棒性

items.title: Large Language Models and Social Media Information Integrity: Opportunities, Challenges, and Research Directions
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools that impact information integrity on social media platforms. This comprehensive review examines the dual role of LLMs in both facilitating and mitigating various information integrity challenges, including misinformation, disinformation, fake news, social bots, and privacy concerns. \textcolor{black}{We conduct a comprehensive review of the literature from 2019 to 2024, screening 1048 studies and performing an in-depth analysis of 215 representative papers. This systematic approach allows us to identify key patterns in how LLMs influence the information security in social media ecosystems.} Through a systematic analysis of papers from multiple databases, our findings reveal that while LLMs can enhance detection capabilities for malicious content and enable sophisticated defense mechanisms, they simultaneously pose risks by enabling the generation of highly convincing, deceptive content. We categorize and analyze the potential and challenges across different dimensions of information integrity, examining technical capabilities, ethical implications, and privacy concerns. The study demonstrates critical gaps in current approaches, particularly in cross-lingual detection, real-time monitoring, and privacy-preserving implementations. We conclude by proposing future research directions and recommendations for stakeholders to leverage LLMs while mitigating risks in social media information integrity.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）与社交媒体信息完整性关系的系统性综述，发表于2024年，作者团队来自多所高校。研究背景是：LLM在社交媒体平台上的广泛应用既可能加剧虚假信息、深度伪造、社交机器人等威胁，也为检测和防御提供了新工具。核心问题是：LLM究竟如何双向影响信息完整性？当前技术存在哪些缺口？未来应如何发展？作者采用系统性文献综述方法，筛选了2019至2024年间1048项研究，并对其中215篇代表性论文进行深入分析，覆盖多个学术数据库。研究发现：一方面，LLM显著增强了恶意内容检测、自动化事实核查和对抗性防御的能力；另一方面，LLM也能被用来生成高度逼真且具有欺骗性的内容，从而放大虚假信息、操纵舆论、侵犯隐私。文章将信息完整性挑战划分为多个维度，包括错误信息、虚假信息、假新闻、社交机器人和隐私问题，分别梳理了LLM带来的机遇与风险，并讨论了技术能力、伦理影响和隐私关切。此外，作者明确指出当前方法存在三大关键缺口：跨语言检测能力不足、实时监控机制薄弱、隐私保护实现缺失。最后，论文提出了未来研究方向，并为平台方、政策制定者和技术社区提供了平衡利用LLM与降低风险的初步建议。适合关注AI安全、社交媒体治理、虚假信息检测的研究人员、安全分析师和平台治理从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM正在重塑社交媒体信息生态，蓝队需要理解其双重性：既可用于自动化防御，也可能被攻击者滥用生成虚假内容。本文系统梳理了攻防全景和已知缺口，为安全团队规划检测策略和风险评估提供参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响社交媒体平台的信息完整性防护体系，包括虚假信息检测、社交机器人识别、隐私保护等场景；对安全运营中涉及内容分析、异常账号检测的团队具有迁移参考价值。

items.title: Combating Knowledge Corruption in Agent Systems: A Byzantine-Tolerant Secure Collaborative RAG Framework
items.summary: While retrieval-augmented generation systems partially address the hallucination issues in large language models, it also introduces new vulnerabilities to knowledge corruption attacks. Adversaries exploit these vulnerabilities by poisoning documents provided by RAG system to manipulate LLM outputs. To counter this threat, we propose SecureCollaRAG, a Byzantine-tolerant collaborative RAG framework leveraging Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism. Our approach enables agent system to securely verify document provenance through dynamic GNN-based credibility scoring, effectively preventing stealthy knowledge corruption attacks while preserving essential domain knowledge integrity. Through extensive evaluations and formal analysis, we demonstrate that SecureCollaRAG maintains robustness against attackers under non-IID data distributions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统虽在一定程度上缓解了大型语言模型(LLM)的幻觉问题，但同时也引入了知识腐败攻击的新漏洞。攻击者可通过向RAG系统提供的文档中注入恶意内容(即文档投毒)来操纵LLM的输出，从而破坏系统的可靠性和安全性。针对这一威胁，本文提出了SecureCollaRAG——一个拜占庭容错(byzantine-tolerant)的协作RAG框架，其核心创新在于引入多源知识验证机制(Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism)。具体而言，该框架利用基于动态图神经网络(GNN)的可信度评分，使智能体系统能够安全地验证文档来源，有效防止隐蔽的知识腐败攻击，同时保持关键领域知识的完整性。作者通过广泛的实验和形式化分析证明，SecureCollaRAG在非独立同分布(non-IID)数据分布下仍能对攻击者保持鲁棒性。这一研究为构建更加安全可靠的LLM应用提供了新的思路，尤其适用于多代理协作和知识密集型场景。适合AI安全、LLM应用开发和RAG系统设计的研究与工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG已成企业知识库标配，文档投毒可使模型输出被操纵，威胁决策可信度。该框架提出拜占庭容错与GNN可信评分，为AI供应链安全提供可借鉴的防御范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面涵盖所有依赖RAG的LLM系统，尤其是多代理协作与外部文档检索场景；其验证机制可迁移至边缘缓存、报告核验等需溯源的数据流。
defense_advice_zh: 在RAG管线上增加文档来源可信度验证，引入动态GNN评分监控异常文本簇，并定期审计知识库中毒痕迹。

items.why_it_matters: RAG已成企业知识库标配，文档投毒可使模型输出被操纵，威胁决策可信度。该框架提出拜占庭容错与GNN可信评分，为AI供应链安全提供可借鉴的防御范式。

items.title: Manipulation-Proof Oblivious Audits against Deceptive Model Providers
items.summary: Audits have emerged as a critical instrument for algorithmic governance, providing a mechanism for external scrutiny and governance of machine learning models. However, ensuring the integrity of such assessments remains a challenging issue. For instance in regulatory contexts, audits are typically declared or easily detected, thus enabling model providers to manipulate the process, whether intentionally or inadvertently. This vulnerability is particularly acute in the context of fairness evaluations, in which providers can often infer sensitive attributes and strategically equalize allocation rates between groups to satisfy fairness metrics. In this paper, we introduce a novel audit protocol designed to significantly increase the post-audit detectability of such manipulations by enabling the auditor to query the model in an oblivious manner. Our approach leverages a Private Information Retrieval mechanism to require the provider to label a large set of instances, while preventing it from knowing which subset will ultimately be used for the audit. The protocol is efficient, imposes minimal overhead on the auditor, and requires no modification to the audited model, its training procedure, or its inference pipeline. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, under this protocol, a provider attempting to hide unfairness must falsify a significantly larger number of responses, thereby increasing both the difficulty and the likelihood of detection of manipulation. Experimental results across representative audit scenarios confirm the effectiveness and practicality of our approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注机器学习模型审计中的完整性挑战。在监管场景下，审计通常是公开或可被检测的，模型提供方可能有意或无意地操纵审计过程，尤其是在公平性评估中，提供方可以推断敏感属性并策略性地调整不同组别的分配率以满足公平性指标。为此，论文提出了一种新颖的审计协议，通过让审计方以 oblivious（ oblivious ）方式查询模型，显著提高审计后操纵行为的可检测性。核心思想是利用私有信息检索（PIR）机制，要求模型提供方标注大量实例，但无法知道哪些子集最终会被用于审计。该协议高效，对审计方施加的额外开销极小，并且无需修改被审计模型、训练过程或推理管线。作者提供了理论保证，证明在该协议下，试图隐藏不公平性的提供方必须伪造更多响应，从而增加操纵的难度和被发现的概率。实验在多个代表性审计场景中验证了方法的有效性和实用性。该研究对算法治理、AI 公平性审计和第三方模型评估具有参考价值，适合算法审计研究者、AI 治理政策制定者以及平台安全团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为模型公平性审计提供了抗操纵的协议设计，可提升第三方审计的可信度，直接支持监管要求下的可靠性验证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于外部审计、监管合规评估、公正性验证等场景，可迁移到需要防止模型提供方规避审查的各类 ML 服务。
detection_signals_zh: 审计查询采用 PIR 协议，提供方无法获知具体审计子集
协议可检测到异常大量的响应伪造
通过理论保证和实验验证提升操纵可检测性
defense_advice_zh: 采用 oblivious 查询机制增加审计不可预测性
结合 PIR 协议设计标准化的审计流程
在审计指南中明确要求提供方配合大规模标注以降低操纵空间

items.why_it_matters: 为模型公平性审计提供了抗操纵的协议设计，可提升第三方审计的可信度，直接支持监管要求下的可靠性验证。

items.title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
items.summary: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自主网络防御系统鲁棒性研究不足的问题，提出了一种名为 Trident 的智能体化大语言模型（LLM）红队框架。当前 DRL 防御模型几乎只用静态、启发式红队进行评测，无法反映真实自适应攻击者的威胁；同时，具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽已提升 LLM 推理能力，但缺少可用于网络安全的基准环境与交互数据集。Trident 由三个组件构成：一是在 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 隔离沙箱中搭建的动态基准环境；二是包含超过 13,000 条高保真红蓝对抗轨迹的数据集，用于 RLVR 训练；三是“代码即策略”的 RLVR 智能体架构（Trident Agentic）。该架构将红队训练建模为上下文赌博机问题，采用“日志摘要器-规划器-编码器”三分设计：可训练的规划器根据压缩的执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的编码器负责把策略转换为可运行的 Python 代码并部署，使其能攻击实时 DRL 防御者。实验表明，仅用一个可训练的 7B 规模规划器，Trident 即可让蓝方防御性能相比静态红队基线平均下降 522%，并且能自主发现诱饵规避、自适应状态优先级选择等静态启发式完全无法揭示的新兴行为。该工作揭示了现有 DRL 自主防御系统存在的根本性脆弱点，为构建更真实的红队评估平台及将 RLVR 应用于网络攻防提供了重要数据集与方法论基础。适合安全自动化研究者、DRL 防御系统开发者和红队工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究证明现有 DRL 自主防御系统极易被自适应智能体攻破，仅用单一 7B 规划器就能使防御性能骤降 522%，警示蓝队不能依赖静态评估结果，必须重新审视自动化防御的对抗鲁棒性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于 DRL 的自动响应/自愈系统；其评估基准与方法可迁移至其他学习型安全防护机制的鲁棒性检验。
defense_advice_zh: 将自适应红队模拟纳入 DRL 防御模型的标准化评估流程，避免仅依据静态脚本判定防御有效。
监控防御系统在未知策略下的性能突变，尤其是当攻击者具备动态规划能力时。
对 DRL 防御训练环境引入多样化对抗策略，提高模型在攻击者适应下的泛化能力。

items.title: Adversarial Attacks for Good: A Survey of Proactive Protection across the Visual Content Lifecycle
items.summary: Once visual content enters an AI pipeline, its owner often retains little technical control over how it is used. Legal and regulatory remedies can address misuse, but many technical interventions must be applied earlier, when content is released or accessed. This survey examines the protective paradigm that has grown around this intervention point, which we call \emph{adversarial attacks for good}. Perturbations and structured signals long studied as attacks on learned models are instead applied by data owners, creators, platforms, or auditors to disrupt unauthorized automation or support later accountability. Five research communities have arrived at this inversion largely independently, each addressing a different stage of a visual asset's lifecycle: privacy filters against unwanted recognition at sharing time, unlearnable examples against unauthorized training, generative safeguards against malicious editing or imitation, adversarial CAPTCHAs for access control against automated agents, and provenance mechanisms for post-circulation attribution. Although developed in separate venues with incompatible success criteria, many of these methods exploit persistent gaps between human perception, semantic interpretation, and machine inference, suggesting that the paradigm remains relevant as visual pipelines evolve toward multimodal models and autonomous agents. To make their claims comparable, we evaluate all five families along shared axes of transferability, adaptability, and deployment readiness. Across the lifecycle, we find that most protections are still validated mainly against static or weakly adaptive adversaries, while evidence beyond controlled benchmarks remains scarce. We close by consolidating cross-stage countermeasures and open problems for robust, composable, and deployable owner-side protection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇面向视觉内容全生命周期的综述，系统梳理了“用于善意的对抗攻击”（adversarial attacks for good）这一新兴防御范式。核心背景是：当视觉内容进入AI管道后，所有者对其后续使用方式几乎失去技术控制，法律和监管手段虽能事后追责，但许多技术干预必须在内容发布或访问时提前施加。作者将这一干预点上的保护手段统称为“用于善意的对抗攻击”，即把原本用于攻击学习模型的扰动或结构化信号，反过来由数据所有者、创作者、平台或审计方使用，以破坏未经授权的自动化处理或支持后续问责。综述识别出五个在视觉资产生命周期不同阶段独立发展的研究社区：1）隐私过滤：在分享时防止面部识别等非预期识别；2）不可学习样本：阻止未经授权使用数据进行模型训练；3）生成式防护：防止恶意编辑或模仿；4）对抗性验证码：用于访问控制以对抗自动化代理；5）溯源机制：支持内容流通后的归属与溯源。尽管这些方法在不同场合、以不同成功标准独立发展，但它们都利用了人类感知、语义理解与机器推断之间的持久差距，并且随着视觉管道向多模态模型和自主代理演进，这一范式仍具有现实意义。为了让不同方法可比，作者沿跨迁移性、适应性和部署就绪性三个共享轴评估了这五类方法。综述发现，大多数保护手段目前仍主要针对静态或弱自适应攻击者验证，超出受控基准的实际证据稀缺。最后，作者整合了跨阶段的对抗措施，并提出了构建稳健、可组合、可部署的所有者侧保护所需的开放问题。该综述的主要贡献在于统一了五个独立领域的概念框架，提供了横向比较维度，并指出了当前研究与实际部署之间的差距。适合关注AI安全、数据隐私、内容溯源以及对抗机器学习的蓝队安全工程师、AI系统开发者和政策研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 综述首次统一了五个分散的视觉内容主动防护研究社区，提供了横向对比框架，帮助蓝队了解现有防御手段的适应性与部署差距，并为未来构建稳健的多模态防护提供方向。

items.title: Post-Hoc Trajectory-Risk Certification for Modular LLM-Based Security Agents
items.summary: Autonomous security agents operate as staged pipelines, such as classifying network traffic and then attributing attacks to a specific technique. Split conformal prediction gives each stage finite-sample coverage, but deployment requires a trajectory-level guarantee across the full chain. These guarantees do not compose automatically when stages are independently trained and calibrated. Bonferroni allocation is distribution-free but conservative under correlated errors. We show that a natural pairwise-correlation extension to three or more stages is invalid because it gives a lower rather than an upper bound, and derive a valid spanning-tree alternative. We distinguish whether stages are dependent from whether an audit sample is large enough to certify that dependence, and give matching upper and information-theoretic lower sample-complexity bounds. We also show that coarse-to-fine label selection can create near-perfect measured correlation without learned dependence. On a two-stage intrusion-detection pipeline across 6 open LLMs and 2 datasets, removing this artifact reduces measured correlation from near 1 to 0-0.78. A direct audit of trajectory failure becomes 13.7% tighter than Bonferroni once the audit reaches the required sample size, but is worse when undersized. A modular certificate using per-stage certificates and a pairwise overlap bound yields a positive average gain of 0.6%, quantifying the cost of lacking joint access. Same-model, cross-model, and permuted-pairing tests show that residual dependence reflects shared sample difficulty, not shared model representations. Average trajectory coverage across 12 configurations is 92.7% +/- 2.4% at alpha = 0.10. Under cross-dataset deployment, single-step miscoverage reaches 100% even when accuracy remains 78%, showing that distribution shift destroys calibrated confidence before raw accuracy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究模块化 LLM 安全代理的轨迹级风险认证问题。此类代理通常以分阶段流水线方式工作，例如先对网络流量进行分类，再进行攻击技术归因。分裂共形预测可以为每个阶段提供有限样本覆盖保证，但部署时需要整个链路的轨迹级风险保证。由于各阶段独立训练和校准，这些单阶段保证并不能自动组合。作者首先指出，Bonferroni 分配虽然分布自由，但在误差相关时过于保守。接着，作者证明自然将两阶段成对相关扩展至三阶段及以上是无效的，因为它给出的是下界而非上界，并由此推导出一种有效的生成树替代方法。文中严格区分了“阶段之间是否存在依赖”与“审计样本是否足够大以证明这种依赖”两个概念，并给出了匹配的样本复杂度上界与信息论下界。此外，作者发现粗到细的标签选择会制造近乎完美的测量相关性，而实际上并不存在学习到的依赖。在包含 6 个开源 LLM 和 2 个数据集的两阶段入侵检测流水线实验中，去除该伪影后，测量相关性从接近 1 降至 0 到 0.78。当审计样本量达到要求时，直接审计轨迹失败比 Bonferroni 方法紧 13.7%，但样本不足时效果更差。作者提出的模块化证书（利用每阶段证书与成对重叠界）带来 0.6% 的正平均增益，量化了缺乏联合访问的代价。相同模型、跨模型和置换配对测试显示，残差依赖主要反映共享样本难度而非共享模型表示。在 12 个配置下，平均轨迹覆盖率在 alpha=0.10 时为 92.7% ± 2.4%。跨数据集部署时，即使准确率仍为 78%，单步错误覆盖率却达到 100%，表明分布偏移会在原始准确率下降之前破坏校准置信度。该研究为多阶段安全代理提供了轨迹级可靠性认证的理论基础，并揭示了伪相关与分布偏移的潜在危害。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对依赖 LLM 的多阶段安全代理而言，仅评估单步准确率远远不够。本文提供轨迹级风险认证方法，并揭示分布偏移如何先于准确率摧毁校准置信度，是构建可信自主安全系统的关键参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至基于 LLM 的入侵检测、网络流量分析、自动响应编排等多阶段安全流水线，也可用于任何需要端到端不确定性保证的模块化 ML 系统。
defense_advice_zh: 在多阶段安全代理中采用模块化轨迹级证书，避免仅依赖单阶段覆盖。
监控跨数据集部署时的校准置信度退化，不要只关注原始准确率。
警惕粗到细标签选择导致的伪相关，使用置换测试验证真实依赖。

items.why_it_matters: 对依赖 LLM 的多阶段安全代理而言，仅评估单步准确率远远不够。本文提供轨迹级风险认证方法，并揭示分布偏移如何先于准确率摧毁校准置信度，是构建可信自主安全系统的关键参考。

items.title: Dimension Rigidity and Projective Geometry of Trace-Product Switchings of the Gold Cube
items.summary: We completely classify a natural scalar trace-product switching of the Gold almost perfect nonlinear function $x\mapsto x^3$ in every even dimension. Nontrivial switchings occur only for $n=4,6,8$: the admissible coefficients are, respectively, the nonzero trace-zero elements, the six elements of multiplicative order nine, and $\mathbb{F}_4^{*}$. For every even $n\geq10$, no nonzero coefficient is admissible. The infinite range is excluded by additive-character estimates on a Fermat cubic, with exact finite bridges for $n=10,12$. The raw coefficient lists for $n=6,8$ appeared earlier in Arshad's dissertation; our contribution is their intrinsic description, a proof uniform in the dimension, and the resulting dimension-rigidity theorem. We also classify normalized rank-two extensions in dimension eight by $\mathbb{P}^{1}(\mathbb{F}_4)$. A binary trace selector accepts two coefficient values at each non-base projective point, and the eight accepted marked switchings form exactly two extended-affine, hence two CCZ, classes. A centre-independent low-rank derivative criterion reduces each rank-$r$ candidate to $2^r-1$ membership tests in precomputed forbidden sets. The global APN classes reached are known; the results describe their local organization around the Gold centre and rule out this switching mechanism in all larger even dimensions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Gold几乎完美非线性（APN）函数 x↦x^3 的一类自然标量迹积切换（trace-product switching）进行了完整分类，研究覆盖所有偶数维度。作者证明了非平凡切换仅出现在维度 n=4,6,8 中：对应可容许系数分别为非零迹零元素、乘法阶为9的6个元素以及 F_4^*。对于所有偶数 n≥10，不存在非零可容许系数。无限范围的排除依赖于对Fermat三次曲线的加性特征估计，并针对 n=10,12 给出了精确的有限桥接。n=6,8 的原始系数列表曾出现在Arshad的学位论文中，本文的贡献在于给出这些系数的内在描述、一个对维度统一的证明，以及由此得到的维度刚性定理。此外，作者在维度八中通过 P^1(F_4) 分类了归一化秩二扩展。一个二元迹选择器在每个非基射影点接受两个系数值，八个接受的标记切换恰好形成两个扩展仿射类，进而形成两个CCZ类。一个与中心无关的低秩导数准则将每个秩-r 候选者简化为在预计算禁止集中的 2^r-1 次成员测试。所达到的全局APN类别是已知的；这些结果描述了它们在Gold中心周围的局部组织，并排除了所有更大偶数维度中的这种切换机制。本文属于数学与信息论交叉研究，主要面向APN函数、密码学中的S盒设计以及有限几何研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究系统性地刻画了APN函数切换的维度限制，有助于理解密码学S盒的构造空间，避免在高维中依赖无效切换机制，为设计者提供理论边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响APN函数与密码S盒的构造理论，对偶数维度的切换机制给出了穷尽性结论，可直接用于评估现有构造的可行性。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究系统性地刻画了APN函数切换的维度限制，有助于理解密码学S盒的构造空间，避免在高维中依赖无效切换机制，为设计者提供理论边界。

items.title: PriDyG: Privacy-preserving Dynamic Graph Inference with LLM-GNN Collaboration
items.summary: Graph inference over relational data can expose sensitive edge information, and this risk becomes more severe in dynamic graphs, where repeated model updates cause privacy loss to accumulate. We formulate Edge-level Differentially Private Dynamic Graph Inference (EDG) and propose PriDyG, a private inference framework that combines GNN-based structural learning with LLM-based semantic reasoning. PriDyG introduces incremental private multi-hop aggregation, which buffers newly arrived edges and processes each edge exactly once. By parallel composition, the total privacy cost equals that of a single static release, independent of the number or schedule of model updates. Compared with geometrically decaying budget allocation, incremental aggregation avoids exponentially increasing noise while preserving exact one-hop signals and at least half of two-hop information transfers. PriDyG further complements privatized GNN outputs with LLM predictions derived solely from node text, incurring no additional edge-level privacy cost. Experiments on four benchmarks for node classification and link prediction show that PriDyG consistently outperforms geometrically decaying baselines under the same privacy budget and matches the utility of naive per-update retraining while reducing cumulative privacy cost by up to three orders of magnitude.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究动态图上的边级差分隐私推理问题。在动态图中，关系数据不断更新，若反复用新数据训练模型，隐私损失会随更新次数累积，构成严重威胁。作者形式化定义了边级差分隐私动态图推理（EDG）问题，并提出 PriDyG 框架，将基于 GNN 的结构学习与基于 LLM 的语义推理相结合。PriDyG 的核心创新是增量私有多跳聚合：它缓冲新到达的边，使每条边恰好被处理一次，并通过并行组合原理，使得总隐私成本等价于单次静态发布，与模型更新的次数或排程无关。与几何衰减预算分配方案相比，增量聚合避免了指数增长的噪声，同时保留精确的一跳信号和至少一半的两跳信息传递。此外，PriDyG 利用仅基于节点文本的 LLM 预测来补充加噪后的 GNN 输出，不产生任何额外的边级隐私成本。在四个基准数据集上针对节点分类和链接预测任务进行实验，结果表明 PriDyG 在相同隐私预算下始终优于几何衰减基线，并在降低累计隐私成本达三个数量级的同时，达到与朴素逐次更新重训练相近的效用。该工作为动态图上的隐私保护推理提供了新思路，适合研究差分隐私、图神经网络和 LLM 协同的学者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 动态图模型更新会导致隐私预算快速耗尽，PriDyG 提出的增量聚合策略可大幅降低隐私累积，为需要持续发布图推理结果的实际系统提供了更实用的差分隐私方案，值得隐私保护从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于社交网络、通信记录、金融交易等动态关系数据的私有推理场景，可迁移到任何需要边级差分隐私且模型频繁更新的图机器学习管道中。

items.why_it_matters: 动态图模型更新会导致隐私预算快速耗尽，PriDyG 提出的增量聚合策略可大幅降低隐私累积，为需要持续发布图推理结果的实际系统提供了更实用的差分隐私方案，值得隐私保护从业者关注。

items.title: Behavioral Skill Reconstruction: Reconstructing Hidden Functionality from LLM Agent Skills
items.summary: Closed source agent skills may encode proprietary instructions, scripts, constants, and data. Providers may offer their capabilities as services while keeping the underlying packages hidden. Prior work focuses on prompt injection attacks that directly disclose these artifacts, and existing defenses accordingly aim to prevent such leakage. However, preventing file disclosure does not prevent users from recovering the functionality those files implement. This raises a fundamental question: can a user reconstruct a skill's functionality through ordinary use while its files remain hidden? We study behavioral skill reconstruction (BSR), in which an attacker uses valid task requests and observed responses to build a functional clone of a hidden skill. We introduce SkillClone, a black-box attack that clones a target skill by forming an interface hypothesis from its public advertisement, issuing structured benign probes, synthesizing an executable replica, and iteratively repairing it through differential validation against the victim skill. Across 30 skills spanning rules, tables, procedures, and algorithms, SkillClone achieves exact or partial recovery on held-out inputs for several targets. Iterative requerying closes gaps missed by single-round reconstruction. Because SkillClone uses only legitimate interactions, disclosure-focused defenses provide limited coverage, and less detailed skill descriptions offer limited protection. These results show that file secrecy alone does not ensure functional secrecy. Defenses must also limit cumulative information leakage from ordinary use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一种针对 LLM Agent 技能（skill）的新型攻击范式——行为技能重建（Behavioral Skill Reconstruction, BSR）。在云服务或封闭式 API 场景中，服务提供商可能将专有指令、脚本、常量或数据封装为隐藏的技能包，仅向用户开放调用接口，而用户无法直接读取底层文件。以往攻击主要依赖提示注入（prompt injection）来直接泄露这些文件，防御方也相应加强了对直接泄露的检测与阻断。然而，本文指出：即使阻止文件泄露，用户仍可能通过正常使用技能来恢复其实现的功能。为此，作者提出了一种黑盒攻击方法 SkillClone，其核心流程包括：1）根据技能的公开广告信息建立接口假设；2）发送结构化的良性探测请求；3）基于观察到的响应合成一个可执行的功能克隆；4）与被攻击的原始技能进行差分验证，并迭代修复克隆体。作者在 30 个涵盖规则、表格、流程和算法等类型的技能上进行了实验，结果显示 SkillClone 在保留测试集上对多个目标实现了完全或部分恢复，且迭代重查能够弥补单轮重建的遗漏。由于该方法仅使用合法交互，现有的基于防御泄露的机制覆盖有限，而较模糊的技能描述也只能提供十分有限的保护。研究表明，文件保密性并不等同于功能保密性，防御方必须关注普通使用过程中的累积信息泄露。对于 LLM Agent 生态的安全设计者、API 提供方和安全研究者而言，该工作揭示了封闭模型服务中隐藏功能可被逆向复现的现实风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究打破了“隐藏文件即可保护功能”的假设，证明仅通过正常使用即可重建专有技能，对依赖保密实现来保护知识产权的 LLM Agent 服务构成实际威胁，促使防御方重新思考信息暴露边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有以黑盒 API 形式提供 LLM Agent 技能的服务商，尤其是将专有算法、规则或数据作为核心竞争力的场景；也可能适用于模型即服务（MaaS）中可观察到的行为逆向工程。
detection_signals_zh: 重复且结构化的良性请求序列，符合差分验证模式
用户在同一时间段内对同一技能发送大量类似输入并对比输出
请求参数包含边界值或覆盖表格/规则分支的枚举模式
defense_advice_zh: 限制单一用户对技能的高频访问和输出差分能力
对输出做聚合扰动或添加不改变功能的微小噪声，防止精确重建
对技能调用实施异常检测，识别针对特定技能的探测行为
定期评估技能在长期交互中的累积信息泄露风险

items.why_it_matters: 该研究打破了“隐藏文件即可保护功能”的假设，证明仅通过正常使用即可重建专有技能，对依赖保密实现来保护知识产权的 LLM Agent 服务构成实际威胁，促使防御方重新思考信息暴露边界。

items.title: Understanding Fault Tolerance of Adversarially Robust Pruned Models
items.summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on resource-constrained neuromorphic hardware face three concurrent challenges: the need for model compression through pruning, vulnerability to adversarial input perturbations, and susceptibility to hardware-induced weight faults such as stuck-at-zero errors. While each of these factors has been studied in isolation, their combined effects on model reliability have received little attention. This paper presents an empirical investigation of how pruning, adversarial training, and hardware fault injection interact to affect the robustness of convolutional neural networks. Using a compact three-layer CNN trained on MNIST, we conduct three experiments: (1) comparing the fault tolerance of naturally and adversarially trained models under simultaneous hardware faults and adversarial attacks, (2) evaluating how pruning affects adversarial robustness, and (3) characterizing the joint accuracy surface across fault rates, adversarial perturbation magnitudes, and pruning levels. Our results show that adversarial training improves robustness against input perturbations but increases sensitivity to stuck-at-zero weight faults. Contrary to intuition, pruning did not significantly increase fault sensitivity, and varying the pruning level had little effect across fault rates and attack strengths. These results highlight the need to jointly consider adversarial robustness and hardware reliability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对资源受限神经形态硬件上部署的深度神经网络（DNN）所面临的三个并发挑战进行了实证研究：剪枝导致的模型压缩、对抗性输入扰动、以及硬件故障（如 stuck-at-zero 权重错误）的影响。以往工作通常只孤立地研究这些因素，而本文首次联合考察剪枝、对抗训练和硬件故障注入如何共同影响卷积神经网络的鲁棒性。作者使用一个在 MNIST 上训练的紧凑三层 CNN，设计了三个实验：(1) 在同时存在硬件故障和对抗攻击的情况下，比较自然训练模型与对抗训练模型的容错能力；(2) 评估剪枝对对抗鲁棒性的影响；(3) 刻画故障率、对抗扰动幅度和剪枝水平三者联合作用下的精度曲面。实验结果表明：对抗训练虽然能提升对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但会显著增加对 stuck-at-zero 权重故障的敏感性；与直觉相反，剪枝并未显著增加故障敏感性，改变剪枝水平对故障率和攻击强度的影响也很小。这些发现强调了在部署神经形态硬件时，必须联合考虑对抗鲁棒性与硬件可靠性，而不能只针对单一因素进行优化。该研究为设计同时具备对抗安全性和硬件容错能力的模型提供了实证依据，适合硬件安全、对抗机器学习以及边缘 AI 部署领域的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次联合揭示对抗训练与硬件故障之间的权衡，提醒安全从业者在评估模型安全性时不能忽略底层硬件的可靠性约束。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对神经形态芯片、边缘 AI 设备中的模型部署有直接参考价值，可迁移至其他硬件故障模型（如随机位翻转）与更大规模数据集的验证。

items.why_it_matters: 首次联合揭示对抗训练与硬件故障之间的权衡，提醒安全从业者在评估模型安全性时不能忽略底层硬件的可靠性约束。

items.title: Open-World Darknet Traffic Recognition Under Leave-One-Service-Out Evaluation
items.summary: Darknet traffic recognition is critical for cyber threat intelligence, as anonymity networks are often used to conceal malicious activity. However, most existing studies rely on closed-world evaluation, assuming all service categories are known during training and testing, which is unrealistic in real-world environments. This paper presents an open-world darknet traffic classification framework using leave-one-service-out evaluation and uncertainty-aware classification with Random Forest and XGBoost models. Experimental results demonstrate significant performance degradation when transitioning from closed-world to open-world settings, demonstrating that closed-world evaluation substantially overestimates deployment robustness. For example, XGBoost Macro-F1 decreases from 88.8% to 46.1% in the I2P environment, while Random Forest performance drops from 87.4% to 45.7%. Although uncertainty-based rejection slightly improves robustness, strong behavioral similarity between known and unknown services leads to frequent misclassification. Semantic absorption analysis further shows that FreeNet video traffic is classified as browsing traffic with an 88.1% assignment rate, while I2P peer-to-peer traffic is absorbed into FTP-related behavior with an 83.4% assignment rate. The findings demonstrate that behavioral overlap remains a major challenge for reliable open-world darknet traffic classification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究暗网流量的开放世界识别问题。传统暗网流量分类研究大多采用封闭世界评估，即假设训练和测试阶段涉及的服务类别完全已知，这在实际部署中并不现实。作者提出一种基于留一服务法（leave-one-service-out）评估的开放世界暗网流量分类框架，结合随机森林（Random Forest）和XGBoost模型，并引入基于不确定性的拒绝机制。实验使用I2P、FreeNet等暗网环境的数据，对比封闭世界与开放世界下的性能。结果表明，从封闭世界转向开放世界时，模型性能显著下降：XGBoost在I2P环境下的Macro-F1从88.8%降至46.1%，随机森林从87.4%降至45.7%。不确定性拒绝虽能小幅提升鲁棒性，但已知与未知服务之间的强行为相似性导致频繁误分类。语义吸收分析进一步显示，FreeNet视频流量以88.1%的比例被分类为浏览流量，而I2P点对点流量以83.4%的比例被吸收为FTP相关行为。作者强调，行为重叠是开放世界暗网流量可靠分类的主要挑战。该研究对于网络威胁情报、异常检测和匿名网络监控具有参考价值，适合从事流量分析、机器学习安全应用和暗网监测的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了封闭世界评估对暗网流量分类部署鲁棒性的高估问题，为蓝队设计真实场景下的匿名流量检测提供了开放世界评估思路，有助于避免模型在未知服务面前失效。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响暗网流量识别系统的实际部署效果，可迁移至恶意流量检测、异常网络行为识别等场景，提示需要关注未知类别的泛化能力。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了封闭世界评估对暗网流量分类部署鲁棒性的高估问题，为蓝队设计真实场景下的匿名流量检测提供了开放世界评估思路，有助于避免模型在未知服务面前失效。

items.title: Securing Load Balancing over QUIC
items.summary: In-network load balancing outperforms traditional software load balancing while costing less. For instance, programmable switch ASICs can use hashing to select the backend server for the initial packet of each flow at the line rate. However, when the pool of available servers changes, ensuring that the subsequent flow packets are mapped to the same server is challenging due to the data plane's limited memory resources and performance requirements. With the emergence of the QUIC transport protocol, several works show how Connection ID fields (CIDs) can embed the server identifier for all non-initial packets. This approach requires modifications on the server side and violates the QUIC specification, which mandates that CIDs remain unlinkable. In this work, we show that stateless QUIC load balancing can be implemented inside the data plane with no changes to CIDs. Moreover, QUIC packets, except the initial client packet, can bypass the load balancer. We also investigate and mitigate attacks on QUIC in this scenario, including full load balancer bypass and 0-RTT IP spoofing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对在QUIC协议上实现安全且高效的负载均衡问题展开研究。传统网络内负载均衡（in-network load balancing）相比软件负载均衡成本更低，例如可编程交换机ASIC可以利用哈希直连线速为每个流的初始包选择后端服务器。但当服务器池发生变化时，如何保证后续流的数据包仍被映射到同一台服务器，面临着数据平面有限内存和性能需求的挑战。随着QUIC传输协议的出现，已有工作提出利用连接标识（Connection ID, CID）字段嵌入服务器标识，使得所有非初始数据包都能被正确路由，但这种方法需要在服务器端进行修改，且违反QUIC规范中CID必须保持不可关联（unlinkable）的要求。本文提出了一种在数据平面内实现无状态QUIC负载均衡的方案，无需修改CID即可工作，并允许除客户端初始包以外的QUIC数据包绕过负载均衡器直接到达后端服务器。作者还研究了该场景下针对QUIC的攻击，包括完全负载均衡器绕过（full load balancer bypass）和0-RTT IP欺骗（0-RTT IP spoofing），并提出了相应的缓解机制。论文的主要贡献包括：设计并验证了符合QUIC规范的无状态、高性能负载均衡机制；展示了如何在不改变CID的前提下维持流到服务器的连续映射；分析了相关安全威胁并给出防御措施，增强了QUIC负载均衡的整体安全性。该研究对于数据中心网络、边缘计算和基于QUIC的服务集群具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: QUIC协议日益普及，本论文解决其负载均衡中的安全与合规性矛盾，有助于从业者理解如何在无状态数据平面实现高效LB，同时防范0-RTT欺骗等新攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用QUIC的数据中心、CDN、云服务等负载均衡架构，以及依赖QUIC协议的应用部署安全性。
detection_signals_zh: 监控QUIC 0-RTT数据包中的源IP地址突变
注意负载均衡器后未经过校验的异常握手重传
分析数据包路由路径是否跳过预期LB节点
defense_advice_zh: 在QUIC服务器端验证客户端源地址，缓解0-RTT欺骗
对负载均衡器状态进行一致性检查，防止被异常绕过
遵循QUIC规范中CID不可关联的要求，避免使用静态CID标识符

items.why_it_matters: QUIC协议日益普及，本论文解决其负载均衡中的安全与合规性矛盾，有助于从业者理解如何在无状态数据平面实现高效LB，同时防范0-RTT欺骗等新攻击。

items.title: Behavioral Information Leakage in Darknet Traffic: A Multi-Channel Analysis Across Anonymity Networks
items.summary: Existing darknet traffic classification studies largely emphasize predictive accuracy while offering limited insight into the behavioral mechanisms that make encrypted services distinguishable. This paper proposes a behavioral information leakage framework that decomposes flow-level traffic into control, structural, and rhythmic descriptor groups across Tor, I2P, FreeNet, and ZeroNet. The framework combines normalized mutual information analysis with Random Forest-based predictive validation, structural-rhythmic interaction analysis, and cross-network service-variability evaluation under leakage-safe repeated stratified cross-validation. Results show that behavioral leakage varies considerably across anonymity networks. Tor achieves the highest service separability, with a Macro-F1 of 0.7165 and cumulative normalized leakage of 3.9461, whereas FreeNet exhibits the lowest combined leakage of 0.8744. Packet-size organization, directional exchange imbalance, packet tempo, and silence-burst behavior emerge as the main leakage mechanisms. The combined structural-rhythmic representation consistently provides the strongest within-network performance, while leave-one-network-out evaluation reveals limited transferability across anonymity architectures. The proposed Service Variability Index and Leakage Variability Index further show that video exhibits consistent network-specific separability, whereas chat and email demonstrate greater variability across anonymity-network pairs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对暗网流量分类研究中对预测精度过度关注、而对加密服务可区分性的行为机制理解不足的问题，提出了一种行为信息泄露分析框架。研究在 Tor、I2P、FreeNet 和 ZeroNet 四个匿名网络中，将流级流量分解为控制、结构和节奏三类描述符，结合归一化互信息分析、基于随机森林的预测验证、结构-节奏交互分析，以及泄露安全的重复分层交叉验证，开展跨网络服务可变性评估。实验结果表明，行为泄露在不同匿名网络间差异明显：Tor 的服务可分离性最高，Macro-F1 达 0.7165，累积归一化泄露量为 3.9461；FreeNet 的综合泄露量最低，为 0.8744。主要泄露机制包括数据包大小组织、方向交换不平衡、包节奏以及静默-突发行为。结构-节奏组合表示在单一网络内表现最强，而留一网络评估显示跨匿名架构的迁移能力有限。论文进一步提出了服务可变性指数和泄露可变性指数，发现视频服务在不同网络中具有一致的特定可分离性，而聊天和电子邮件在不同匿名网络对之间表现出更大的差异性。该研究为理解匿名网络流量的行为指纹提供了系统化方法，适合网络测量、隐私增强技术和流量分析领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了匿名网络流量的行为侧信道泄露机制，有助于防御方理解即使加密流量也可能被识别服务类型，对流量分类、入侵检测和隐私保护评估具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响 Tor、I2P、FreeNet、ZeroNet 等匿名网络的服务识别与流量分析场景，也可迁移到其他加密协议的行为指纹研究。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了匿名网络流量的行为侧信道泄露机制，有助于防御方理解即使加密流量也可能被识别服务类型，对流量分类、入侵检测和隐私保护评估具有参考价值。

items.title: NEBULA: A Language - Independent Specification for Opaque Rotating Refresh Tokens
items.summary: Refresh tokens are among the most sensitive credentials in modern authentication systems: long-lived, bearer-style, and sufficient to mint access tokens for days or weeks. RFC 9700, the current Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 security, mandates that refresh tokens issued to public clients be rotated on every use with replay (reuse) detection, or be sender-constrained. But the BCP specifies policy, not mechanism: it prescribes no wire format, no storage schema, no ordering of verification steps, no concurrency contract, and no semantics for edge cases such as lost-response retries or key rotation. Implementations may therefore diverge in precisely the corner cases that determine security outcomes. We present NEBULA, a precise, language-independent specification of the RFC 9700 refresh-token model, together with ten conformant reference implementations (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, PHP, C#, Ruby, Elixir, Dart). NEBULA tokens are opaque -- a 128-bit public selector and a 256-bit secret verifier, both CSPRNG output, carrying no claims and no signature -- so token validity is a property of server-side state rather than of cryptographic verification. Its conformance methodology publishes the behavioural suite as data rather than as prose: 38 scenarios in one machine-readable file that every implementation executes through a thin per-language runner, so that drift by transcription is structurally excluded. We describe the specification -- including a compare-and-set rotation contract that closes a reproducible bypass of reuse detection under concurrent refresh -- analyse its security properties including its post-quantum posture, and report on cross-language conformance as a method for multi-implementation security specifications. The specification, implementations, and conformance artefacts are open source under the Apache License 2.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 刷新令牌是 OAuth 2.0 体系中最敏感的凭据之一，具有长期有效、Bearer 属性、可凭其换取访问令牌等特点。RFC 9700 虽要求对公共客户端发放的刷新令牌进行轮换、重用检测或发送方约束，但该 BCP 只规定策略，不规定线格式、存储结构、验证顺序、并发契约及边缘情况语义，导致各实现安全行为不一致。本文提出 NEBULA——一种精确且语言无关的 RFC 9700 刷新令牌模型规范。NEBULA 令牌不透明，由 128 位公开选择器与 256 位秘密验证器组成，均来自 CSPRNG，不含任何声明或签名，因此令牌有效性取决于服务器端状态而非密码学验证。规范定义了一个比较并交换（compare-and-set）轮换契约，能够修复在并发刷新场景下重用检测被绕过的问题。作者还发布了涵盖 38 个场景的机器可读行为套件，并通过十个参考实现（TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、Java、PHP、C#、Ruby、Elixir、Dart）验证跨语言一致性，从结构上排除转录漂移。论文还分析了 NEBULA 的安全属性，包括后量子能力；所有规范、实现及一致性工件均以 Apache License 2.0 开源。该工作为 OAuth 刷新令牌的工程实现提供了可操作的基准，适合认证系统开发者、安全架构师及蓝队人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 刷新令牌是攻击者重点目标，实现差异常导致重用检测绕过等隐患。NEBULA 将 RFC 9700 转化为精确、可验证的规范，并提供参考实现与测试套件，帮助蓝队审计自有认证系统、收敛实现漂移风险，提升认证链路鲁棒性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 OAuth 2.0/OIDC 服务端、API 网关、单点登录系统等涉及刷新令牌轮换与重用检测的场景；其并发安全契约和一致性方法也可迁移到其他多语言安全规范制定。
defense_advice_zh: 生成刷新令牌时使用 CSPRNG，确保不可预测性
实行原子化的轮换操作，防止并发请求绕过重用检测
定期审计刷新令牌存储与验证逻辑，对照 NEBULA 规范进行一致性测试
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估将 NEBULA 规范与测试套件纳入内部 OAuth 实现的审计流程。

items.why_it_matters: 刷新令牌是攻击者重点目标，实现差异常导致重用检测绕过等隐患。NEBULA 将 RFC 9700 转化为精确、可验证的规范，并提供参考实现与测试套件，帮助蓝队审计自有认证系统、收敛实现漂移风险，提升认证链路鲁棒性。
items.recommended_action: 研究跟进，评估将 NEBULA 规范与测试套件纳入内部 OAuth 实现的审计流程。

items.title: Progressive Learning of a Diffusion-based Inpainting Model for Separating Overlapped Fingerprints
items.summary: Overlapped friction ridge patterns are a recurring problem in latent fingerprints recovered from crime scenes and in live-scan scenarios where residual fingerprints on the sensor may corrupt subsequent acquisitions. Existing approaches for separating overlapped fingerprints either rely on rule-based orientation field completion that requires strong domain knowledge or train end-to-end deep neural networks that do not account for domain-specific considerations. This work introduces a diffusion-based pipeline for separating component fingerprints from an image containing overlapping friction ridge patterns. We formulate the separation problem as an inpainting task and progressively learn a diffusion model for this task in multiple stages. Starting from a pre-trained Stable Diffusion model, we progressively incorporate a fingerprint prior, add the ability to complete partial fingerprints, and finally propose \textbf{overlap-aware inpainting} that reconstructs each component print using a diffusion inpainting model based on multi-channel conditioning. Experiments on two public datasets demonstrate that component fingerprints reconstructed using the proposed diffusion-based inpainting method can match with their mated counterparts with very high probability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 重叠指纹是法医现场潜指纹和活体采集场景中常见的问题：传感器上残留的指纹会污染后续采集，犯罪现场提取的潜指纹也常包含多个叠加的摩擦脊线结构。传统分离方法主要依赖基于规则的方向场补全，需要较强的领域知识；而端到端的深度神经网络方法则未充分利用指纹的领域特殊性。本文提出一种基于扩散模型的分离管道，将重叠指纹分离建模为图像修复（inpainting）任务，并采用多阶段渐进学习策略。具体而言，从预训练的 Stable Diffusion 模型出发，逐步注入指纹先验知识，先学习补全部分指纹，再提出“重叠感知修复”（overlap-aware inpainting），通过多通道条件机制利用扩散模型重建每个成分指纹。实验在两个公开数据集上表明，该方法重建出的成分指纹与真实配对指纹有很高的匹配概率，验证了其在法医识别场景中的可行性与有效性。该方法的主要贡献在于将扩散模型与领域先验结合，以数据驱动的修复方式替代手工方向场规则，同时保留了对指纹结构的针对性建模。适合法医图像分析、生物特征识别以及基于扩散模型的图像生成研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 重叠指纹分离是当前法医与活体识别流程中的实际痛点，扩散模型提供了一种无需强规则假设的新思路，能够显著提升重建指纹匹配率，对刑侦与身份认证场景有直接应用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可扩展到其他生物特征重叠场景（如掌纹、足迹），以及传感器残留污染的自清洁处理；也可作为多条件扩散模型在领域专用图像修复上的参考范例。

items.title: FBID: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Robust Out-of-Distribution Attack Detection in IoT Networks
items.summary: Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) has emerged as a promising solution for intrusion detection in heterogeneous IoT environments, as it can improve local adaptation under highly Non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) data distributions. However, existing PFL methods often rely on client-side self-adjustment, which may lead to over-personalization and substantial degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) attack detection. In this paper, we propose Federated Bandit Intrusion Detection (FBID), a novel adaptive PFL framework to address this limitation through server-side personalization control. In particular, FBID employs a contextual multi-armed bandit at the server to dynamically regulate each client's local training intensity according to its observed behavior and update quality. Moreover, FBID introduces a trust-based blending mechanism to derive client-specific interpolation coefficients between the global and local models, thereby preserving global attack-detection knowledge while still allowing beneficial local specialization. Through extensive experiments on the CICIoT2023 dataset under heterogeneous client distributions and OOD stress-test settings, we show that FBID improves individual client OOD Detection Rate (DR) by up to 7.66% and F1-Score (F1) by up to 5.08% (relative) over the strongest stable baseline, while also improving robustness to previously unseen attack classes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向物联网（IoT）网络入侵检测的自适应个性化联邦学习（PFL）框架 FBID（Federated Bandit Intrusion Detection）。研究背景是：在异构 IoT 环境中，数据分布高度非独立同分布（non-IID），传统联邦学习难以适应各客户端的数据差异，而现有 PFL 方法通常依赖客户端侧自我调整，容易导致“过度个性化”，使得当出现训练阶段未见过的攻击（即分布外，OOD 攻击）时，检测性能显著下降。针对这一问题，FBID 的核心思想是在服务器端进行个性化控制，而非完全依赖客户端自发调整。具体而言，FBID 在服务器端引入一个上下文多臂老虎机（contextual multi-armed bandit）机制，根据每个客户端的行为表现和模型更新质量，动态调节该客户端的本地训练强度（如本地训练轮数或学习率等超参数），从而避免过度个性化。此外，FBID 还提出了一种基于信任的混合机制，为每个客户端计算全局模型与本地模型之间的插值系数，使模型既保留全局通用的攻击检测知识，又能利用本地独特模式进行有益的特化。实验基于 CICIoT2023 数据集，并在异构客户端分布和 OOD 压力测试设定下进行。结果表明，与最强的稳定基线相比，FBID 在个体客户端的 OOD 检测率（Detection Rate）上相对提升了最多 7.66%，F1 分数相对提升了最多 5.08%，同时显著增强了对未见攻击类别的鲁棒性。该研究的主要贡献在于：提出了一种新的服务器端个性化控制思路，结合多臂老虎机与信任混合机制，有效平衡了全局知识与局部自适应，并系统验证了其在 OOD 攻击检测上的优势。适合研究联邦学习、物联网安全、入侵检测以及对抗分布偏移的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 IoT 场景下的联邦入侵检测提供了一种抗分布偏移的新思路，解决现有 PFL 过度个性化导致 OOD 攻击漏报的问题。安全团队可借鉴其服务器端动态控制与信任融合思想，提升异构网络中的异常检测鲁棒性。

items.why_it_matters: 为 IoT 场景下的联邦入侵检测提供了一种抗分布偏移的新思路，解决现有 PFL 过度个性化导致 OOD 攻击漏报的问题。安全团队可借鉴其服务器端动态控制与信任融合思想，提升异构网络中的异常检测鲁棒性。

items.title: An Inline Control Architecture for Language Models in Intelligent Transportation Systems
items.summary: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) systems increasingly incorporate large language models (LLMs) for semantic tasks such as message summarization, operator assistance, and decision support at roadside units and edge nodes. Although these components are not part of safety-critical control loops, they introduce prompt-level attack surfaces that are not addressed by traditional V2X security mechanisms focused on authentication and message integrity. This paper presents Guarded-V2X, an inline semantic guardrail architecture for securing LLM-enabled V2X services under real-time constraints. The proposed system integrates rule-based ingress filtering, a lightweight safety classifier, policy-constrained structured generation, trusted-only retrieval, and post-decision adjudication to enforce machine-checkable safety boundaries prior to downstream execution. Guarded-V2X is evaluated using a four-stage experimental pipeline encompassing intrusion vulnerability analysis, calibration and latency benchmarking, guardrail validation, and robustness under adversarial stress. Experiments are conducted on a V2X-aligned simulated dataset derived from RSU advisories, operator messages, and annotated V2X message summaries. Results show that unguarded and prompt-only baselines retain residual vulnerability under multi-turn adversarial trials, while Guarded-V2X consistently reduces intrusion acceptance success rates and eliminates observed unsafe completions in two-turn settings, without exceeding latency budgets for V2X semantic advisory paths.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文面向智能交通系统（ITS）中车联网（V2X）场景下大语言模型（LLM）应用的语义安全防护问题。随着V2X系统在路侧单元和边缘节点中集成LLM用于消息摘要、操作员辅助和决策支持等非安全关键任务，传统的基于认证和消息完整性的安全机制无法覆盖LLM引入的提示词级攻击面。作者提出Guarded-V2X，一种满足实时约束的内联语义护栏架构，用于保护LLM赋能的V2X服务。该架构包含五个核心组件：规则驱动的入站过滤、轻量级安全性分类器、策略约束的结构化生成、可信来源检索以及决策后仲裁机制，从而在下游执行前强制执行机器可检查的安全边界。实验采用四阶段流水线，涵盖入侵漏洞分析、校准与延迟基准测试、护栏有效性验证以及对抗性压力鲁棒性测试，并在面向V2X的模拟数据集上进行，数据来自RSU建议、操作员消息和带标注的V2X消息摘要。结果表明，未加防护和仅依赖提示词的基线在多轮对抗试验下仍存在残余漏洞，而Guarded-V2X在双轮设置中持续降低入侵接受成功率并消除了观察到的非安全补全，同时未超出V2X语义建议路径的延迟预算。论文的主要贡献在于提出了一种面向LLM+V2X的专用防护架构，并系统评估了其在对抗攻击下的有效性和实时性能。适合智能交通系统安全设计者、边缘AI安全研究者和LLM应用防护开发人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM正被引入V2X等基础设施场景，其提示词攻击面是传统信息安全防护的盲区。本文提供了一套可实时运行的防护架构方案和评估方法，对车联网边缘侧AI安全落地具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括V2X路侧单元、边缘LLM服务、智能网联汽车的消息摘要与决策支持模块。该防护思路也可迁移至其他实时要求较高的LLM嵌入式系统，如工业控制、医疗辅助等非安全关键但需强约束的场景。
detection_signals_zh: 多轮对话中出现未经授权的操作指令或异常工具调用
输入提示词包含尝试绕过系统约束的对抗性改写
语义分类器输出置信度低于阈值的不安全生成内容
defense_advice_zh: 对LLM输入采用规则过滤与轻量分类器双重校验
使用策略约束的结构化生成限制输出格式与操作边界
在模型下游执行前增加决策后仲裁环节
对检索源实施可信白名单限制
在部署前进行多轮对抗压力测试评估残余风险
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，重点评估该架构在真实V2X环境中的可部署性和抗对抗鲁棒性，并考虑在内部LLM应用防护设计中引入类似护栏组件。

items.title: Delay Attacks on the German Smart Metering Infrastructure: A Security Analysis of CLS Channel Timing Constraints
items.summary: This work analyzes the feasibility of delay attacks on control signals transmitted via the Controllable Local System (CLS) channel of the German Smart Metering Infrastructure (SMI). It combines theoretical analysis with experimental validation under a threat model aligned to the Common Criteria Protection Profile for the Smart Meter Gateway (SMGW) and assess the potential impact on the power grid if the identified attack vector is exploited across multiple CLS channels simultaneously. We also outline mitigation strategies, including SMGW configuration restrictions, implementation-level changes, and protocol extensions. Our results show that an on-path attacker in the Wide Area Network (WAN) with sufficient contextual knowledge can feasibly execute delay attacks, with a theoretical upper bound of roughly 48 hours for some deployed protocol configurations. Projecting from a single CLS to several hundred thousand CLS devices indicates such an adversary could cause a significant frequency deviation potentially resulting in load shedding. Scaling the attack requires contextual knowledge for each targeted implementation and configuration; whether this knowledge can be broadly reused across CLS channels is uncertain but may become easier to obtain as standardization progresses. Time restricted transmissions in the FNN Steuerbox and in applications using CLS.EEDI are implementation-specific and can therefore be addressed by manufacturers. By contrast, ensuring application-data time limitations in TLS~1.3 requires protocol-level extensions. The TLS extensions proposed here offer a sustainable mitigation while preserving backward compatibility. Other communication channels outside the SMI (for example, proprietary remote terminal units used to control a CLS) are outside this work's scope and may exhibit similar or worse vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对德国智能计量基础设施中可控制本地系统（CLS）信道传输的控制信号，系统研究了延迟攻击的可行性与潜在影响。研究结合理论分析与实验验证，威胁模型对齐了智能电表网关（SMGW）通用标准保护轮廓。结果显示，位于广域网（WAN）中的路径上攻击者若具备充分的上下文知识，可实际执行延迟攻击，部分部署的协议配置下理论延迟上限可达约48小时。将攻击从单个CLS设备扩展到数十万台设备时，攻击者可能造成显著的电网频率偏差，进而引发甩负荷。然而，大规模攻击需要针对每个目标实现和配置获取上下文知识，这类知识能否跨CLS信道复用尚不确定，但随着标准化推进可能更容易获得。论文还提出了多层缓解策略：针对FNN Steuerbox及使用CLS.EEDI的应用，可实施实现层面的时间限制调整；对于TLS 1.3，则需通过协议扩展来确保应用数据的时间限制。作者提出的TLS扩展方案在保持向后兼容性的同时提供了可持续的缓解路径。本文为智能计量基础设施的时序安全提供了重要分析，适合电网安全研究人员、智能计量设备制造商及标准制定者参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了德国智能计量基础设施中CLS信道存在的延迟攻击面，可能影响电网稳定性。安全从业者需了解此类时序攻击在关键基础设施中的潜在风险，并关注其提出的TLS扩展等缓解方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者若同时操纵大量CLS信道，可能导致电网频率偏差和甩负荷，直接影响德国电力供应的可靠性。影响范围涉及智能计量网关、FNN Steuerbox及相关协议实现。
defense_advice_zh: 对SMGW进行配置限制，缩小可攻击面，例如限制CLS信道允许的时序偏移范围。
制造商在FNN Steuerbox及CLS.EEDI应用中实现具体的时间限制防护，确保控制信号在预期窗口内到达。
在TLS 1.3及以上协议中扩展应用数据时间戳校验机制，作为协议级缓解措施，并保持向后兼容性。
